rows.grounds: likhet (optative of likh, to draw/write) + aṣṭa-dala (eight-petal); ritual instruction to draw a diagram
accusative of padma (lotus); object of likhet
tad-madhye (in the middle of that); locative compound indicating placement within the lotus
jñāninaḥ (of the knower/wise one) with sandhi; possessor of the mantra
accusative of manu (mantra/formula); object to be placed or inscribed in the middle
